description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR)'s Expansion and Contraction vault balances on Robinhood Chain: vault ETH, POL manager idle balances, principal ETH/STANDARD deployed in its two direct Uniswap v4 positions, uncollected position fees, total POL-controlled balances, and buyback capacity. Pass history_hours to get the vault snapshot history instead of the latest snapshot, or atBlock to get the snapshot at or before that block (ignored when history_hours is set). Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings. Divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.

atBlock.description: Return the vault snapshot at or before this block instead of the latest one

history_hours.description: When set, return vault snapshot history for this many hours instead of the latest snapshot

name: 1s_std_vaults
title: TSR Vault Balances
